integrity: Exact symbolic coefficient-positivity certificates and uniform-word enumeration are supplied in verify.py; finite tests complement the parameter-uniform proof.
scientific_limitations: The strict imbalance monotonicity is proved only for complete bipartite graphs with iid atomless vertex heights; an independent audit and exhaustive historical-priority search have not occurred. The exact finite tie is handled by the formula, not excluded.
title: A one-crossing peak–valley covariance law on complete bipartite graphs
